en: What color is it?
What color? Is that really your question?
Yeah. So what's the answer?
Umm... Brown?
Oh? You think y'know it already?
Oooh! Someone's sure of himself!
Now, time for your final answer, Kiryu-san! What is the dish I'm going to make for you?
Is it seafood paella?
Oooooh!
Sorry! That ain't it!
It's not?
Well, you'll see when it's done. Just wait a little bit.
You're not going to tell me?
Is it beef stew?
Oooh!
That's right! How'd ya guess!?
Guess I just had a hunch.
I'm gonna make a beef stew like no one's ever had before! I'm real excited about it!
Well, I look forward to it.
Curry?
Huh? I said it was somethin' new!
I just figured curry would be the only sort of thing you knew how to make.
What makes y'say that? You are wrong buddy! And here I was all excited to make it for ya. Now I almost don't even wanna let you try it.
Ahh!
Seeing you just made me remember somethin' wicked important.
Important, huh?
I got slapped with a ticket the other day and I gotta go and pay the fine. This totally sucks.
What did you do?
I went down a street that was only one-way between certain hours.
And you didn't see the signs, I guess.
Yeah. I was wicked surprised.
It's a street I always take and so I didn't even notice. I just happened to be later than usual, is all.
You should go right away. Not paying the fine will make things worse.
Worse how?
You might wind up with some jail time.
What!? They're gonna lock me up!?
Well, more likely you'll get community service.
Yikes! Well in that case, I gotta go run and pay this as soon as my shift's over! Thanks for letting me know, Kiryu-san!
What does that have to do with me?
Um, it doesn't.
But you just said seeing me reminded you of it. Is there some sort of connection in your mind?
Huh? No, not really. I just happened to remember it when I saw ya, that's all.
Uh. Sure, okay.
Oh no! What's wrong?
You first.
But now I'm worried!
Uh, nothing. That just sorta came out.
Sheesh, stop actin' like a baby!
What's worse is now I'm not gonna get my gold license anytime soon.
That's a shame. I take it you hadn't had any traffic violations before?
No, none! Ever since I got my license I've been tryin' my best to get gold.
Keep trying. As long as you try to stay a safe driver, you'll get it eventually.
Okay! I'll keep at it, then! You try not to cause any accidents too, Kiryu-san!
That's typical, though. You're only human. If you drive every day, then you'll wind up with a few violations sooner or later.
That go for you too, Kiryu-san?
Well, I'm a taxi driver. Sometimes my customers ask me to do things that wind up getting me slapped with a violation.
Oh, really? Well, that's a relief.
Still, I really want that gold license.
Well, from now on, just be extra-cautious about being a safe driver.
You don't need one. All a gold license really says is that you're someone who doesn't actually drive enough to get in trouble.
What? But having a gold one means you don't gotta renew it as much, and the fees are cheaper to boot. It's better to have one, ain't it?
Well, I guess money is a factor, but it still shouldn't affect your actual ability to drive.
But money's important! I already gotta pay this stupid fine! It's not like I wanna pay more on top of that.
Did ya work today?
Yes, I did.
Well, in that case, take a load off! What do ya do for a living, anyway?
I'm a taxi driver.
Oh, wow! Hey, maybe I've ridden in your cab before, huh?
That's a secret.
Aww, but I'm curious. C'mon just tell me!
Does it really matter? I'm just your normal, everyday salaryman, that's all.
Huh, for real? I dunno. Ya don't really look like a normal, everyday guy to me.
Well, looks can be deceiving.
So hey, Kiryu-san, would ya say you're the kinda guy folks can rely on?
Sure. People tend to rely on me more than I rely on them.
I knew it! You kinda give off that impression, y'know?
Not really. I'm a burden to my boss and my coworkers.
Really? But ya give off this sorta aura of reliability and all.
Why do you ask, anyway?
I dunno. I guess I thought you and I were like two peas in a pod.
Two peas in a pod? How so?
It's just that folks are pretty much constantly comin' to me for advice on stuff.
Some people even call me Counselor Riku. Ain't that cool?
You do give off that vibe. I feel like I could open up to you about my problems pretty easily.
See what I mean? I actually get lotsa folks coming to me for that sorta thing, if I do say so myself.
In that case, do you mind if I talk to you about something?
Go right ahead! Just lay your worries on ol' Riku-san, here!
Glad I can count on you.
So, what'll it be? Are ya unlucky in love, Kiryu-san? I'm here listenin' if you've got girl problems!
Let me think about it, okay?
I'm just kidding. I can take care of my own problems just fine.
Whaaat? Lame.
That's hard to believe. You don't exactly strike me as being all that reliable.
Get outta town! I have folks comin' to me for advice every day. Every! Day!
That can't be true. For starters, in order to hear someone out, you need to be able to stop and listen to them.
Whatcha talkin' about? I'm a great listener.
What are y'looking at me like that for? I give up! You're a jerk, Kiryu-san!
Sheesh.
Does that pay well?
Ahahaha! I don't charge for it, silly. This is just something I do for my close friends.
Sure, but in your case I'll have to charge ya.
Hey now.
So I had a pretty engaging consultation session with someone a little while back.
Oh, you mean with the Counselor Riku thing?
Yeah. I've got a buncha folks lined up with appointments. There's so many piled up that I can barely keep them all sorted.
It's rough being popular. Soon enough all of your private time is going to be taken up with these consultations of yours.
Nah, it's no big deal. I do it 'cause I like it.
It's fun to have deep conversations with other people, I think. It's a nice way for me to spend my time.
Should you take on that many? How do you even keep everything straight in your head when you have to listen to so many people?
Don't worry! I forget what folks tell me pretty much right away.
Later on folks'll be all, "Hey, thanks for your help with that thing," and I'll be like, "What thing?"
That seems a bit inconsiderate. You're actually able to help people solve their problems that way?
It's fine. The most important thing is for folks to talk to someone about their problems. Whether they solve 'em ain't my problem.
It's better to get it off your chest than to be too afraid to do nothin' about it.
I get you. It's definitely a relief just to be able to talk to someone.
Yep! My duty ain't to actually fix the problem, just to put the other person's mind at ease.
Are you sure? The person with the problem probably considers solving it to be the most important thing and expects you to help.
Well, I... Yeah, I guess that's true. But ain't it kinda weak to expect someone else to solve your problems for ya?
Well, that's what counseling is about, isn't it? You should try to be a bit more sympathetic and thoughtful next time.
Right. I'll try to be more careful from now on.
That's the same as being a hostess. You talk with customers to help them feel better.
Oh, hey, you're right! Haha! I guess I must be well-suited to talkin' to folks for a living.
Heh. It must be your calling.
Ahaha! See, you're pretty good at this talkin' thing too, Kiryu-san.
It's not just about talking, though. The person with the problem probably considers solving it to be the most important thing and expects you to help.
Huh? Y'think so?
If you can't meet their expectations, you should still choose your words carefully. There's always a chance things you say could backfire on you.
Just take care to not say anything inconsiderate.
Geez, Kiryu-san. Lecture much? C'mon, let's change the subject. How 'bout something that's actually fun and all.
Anyone can do that. If all the person needs is someone to listen them, that someone doesn't need to be you.
Well, am I right? Take me for instance. I can listen to someone just fine.
So from now on, if you need someone to talk to, you can talk to me.
No way! That's super lame. Then I'm not gonna have any fun!
You're so mean, Kiryu-san!
Hey, Kiryu-san? So I've got myself a little problem.
That's unusual. People usually come to you for that sort of thing, don't they?
I guess this must be how other folks feel, huh?
I've got something on my mind, too. Think you could hear me out?
What? Why ya gotta bring that up now? I thought y'were gonna listen to my problems!
So ya gonna hear me out or what?
Go ahead. I'll see if I can help you out.
Aw, I knew ya'd say that, Kiryu-san!
I'm not really here for that... Maybe we can go back to some lighter conversation?
Oh, that's right. I'm sorry.
But... I really don't know what I oughta do.
Okay, fine. Tell me what's wrong.
I don't come cheap. But if you want, I'll hear you out.
What? You're chargin' me?
Of course. I think I deserve a little payment for helping you solve your problems.
Well, I guess. I just figured you'd be a good person to talk to about stuff, Kiryu-san.
Heh, okay, okay. Tell me what's wrong.
Just kidding. If you think I can help, I'll hear you out.
Whew! Ya had me real worried for a sec!
Sorry. So, you were saying?
I've got these two friends who come to me separately to talk 'bout stuff. Their names are Yuka-chan and Asumi-chan.
What do they want to talk about?
Well, it's about romance.
You're asking the wrong guy. You should find someone else to talk to about this.
Oh, shush! Just hear me out.
Yuka-chan's living with her boyfriend, and she's wonderin' if they should get hitched.
And Asumi-chan's worryin' her head off because her boyfriend proposed to her.
So what's the problem, exactly?
Well, after they told me all this, I got to thinkin' and put the pieces together.
And I realized both of these girls are thinkin' about marrying the same guy!
It seems the guy's a two-timer. The girl who lives with him thinks he's her boyfriend, but he's just treatin' it like he's renting a room.
These two girls don't know each other?
No, I just know them both. They both said their guy is a host, but I thought that it was only a coincidence at first.
A host, huh? Wait, this sounds like the guy is running a typical host's scam. He's just trying to get girls to visit him as a regular customer.
Right! But I didn't realize that at the time, so I told 'em they should go ahead and get married.
You need to come clean. It'll save them from more hurt later on.
Yeeeah, but since I was all rah-rah thumbs up for them gettin' hitched, now I don't know if I can break the news to them.
I know how you must feel, but the longer you let this go on, the harder it's going to be to tell them.
Ugh, this bites. But you're right. I'll find some way to tell 'em.
Just leave it alone. This isn't the sort of thing you should meddle in.
I guess not...
Instead, the next time a friend comes to you looking for advice, make sure to listen to them carefully. You like doing that, right?
Well yeah, 'course! I just need to keep my trap shut 'til someone asks me for advice.
Hey, you remember that thing we talked about?
Yeah. You mean the two girls who came to you for advice about the same host?
Yeah, that! I just heard some real shady talk 'bout the host in question.
No. Sorry, I don't remember.
Gaaah, I'm talkin' 'bout the two girls who asked me for datin' advice about the same guy!
Ah, yes, now I remember. Your friends who were dating that host.
What sort of talk?
So this host⑬his name's Subaru-san⑬apparently has some secret connections with the yakuza.
Really!? This is seriously bad news, and that's all y'have to say about it?
Having yakuza connections doesn't mean he's bad. He's still the same guy.
Say what? Well, I guess that's true, but... Maybe I asked the wrong person for advice.
That's not good. Respectable women shouldn't get mixed up with the yakuza like that.
Right!? So now I'm in a real pickle!
If they blow all their money on this guy and go flat broke, they might get caught up in the sex trade, or be forced to take loans they gotta pay off.
Hm. Guess there are guys like this no matter where you go.
So, everything that's happened from the start has all been part of some criminal scheme. I gotta tell these girls what I know, right?
